test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 10 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'HEADLIGHT' is written as 'JGCFNKIJV'. How will 'INADVISABLE' be written in that language?
solution:
The position of letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://lh6.googleusercontent.com/svtFnuYE8_W7sJG7xKlyyoDPI8nfwql9qh4eHt79vHbkXqshysbEDm6zXWw2R9Ka2qC_V_V_MvjCOglZ-JNhpqU8YAqqgxvdNQir2JD1f9cMZUEPKcSfcxZDeVXOkI7uBKoVqkZD] 

**Logic: Addition of + 2 in every alphabet.**

'HEADLIGHT' is written as 'JGCFNKIJV'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c606ce6407ffaade1718d7309a9ce56724aac908906e9f474b23debd9b2db05.png] 

Similarly,

'INADVISABLE' is written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5c9dec633ad01894a9832791a74d1780297bfab97c07a50fff9d61adf8eb402.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"KPCFXKUCDNG".**
